title: Code of practice for selection and use of super capacity bucket elevator
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This Indian Standard covers the recommendations for the selection and use of super capacity bucket elevator. 1.2 This Indian Standard also lays down the general requirements for buckets, chain, chain sprockets and fasteners for fixing buckets to chains, casing and drive arrangements for vertical super capacity bucket elevators. 1.3 This Indian Standard does not cover the requirements of inclined super capacity bucket elevators and is also not applicable to elevators handling material which do not behave as bulk solid.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of conveyors terms and definitions

clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for selection and use of super capacity bucket elevator

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
